title: Mechanism of USP21 autoinhibition and histone H2AK119 deubiquitination
authors: Rahman S; Morgan MT; Hicks CW; Gwizdala A; Wolberger C
one_liner_zh: 该文通过冷冻电镜与AlphaFold建模揭示USP21的IDR自抑制及磷酸化解除机制，聚焦IDR介导的酶-底物互作调控，方法上结合AI预测与结构解析，对无序蛋白互作机制建模有直接启发。
abstract: Monoubiquitinated histone H2A lysine 119 (H2AK119ub) is a signature modification associated with transcriptional silencing and heterochromatin formation. Ubiquitin-specific protease 21 (USP21), one of four major deubiquitinating enzymes (DUBs) that target H2AK119ub, plays critical roles in diverse cellular processes 1–4 . The molecular mechanisms by which USP21 specifically deubiquitinates H2AK119ub and is regulated is unknown. USP21 contains a C-terminal USP catalytic domain, preceded by an N-terminal intrinsically disordered region (IDR). We determined the cryo-EM structure of the USP21 catalytic domain bound to an H2AK119ub nucleosome, which reveals a recognition mode that differs from that of two other H2AK119-specific DUBs, Polycomb repressive complex 5 and USP16 6 . We unexpectedly discovered that the N-terminal intrinsically disordered region (IDR) of USP21 inhibits the enzyme’s activity. Using AlphaFold-Multimer to perform a virtual screen of USP21 interactors, we identified kinases that phosphorylate the USP21 IDR and thereby relieve autoinhibition. Modeling of USP21 using AlphaFold3 suggests a structural model explaining the mechanism of autoinhibition. AlphaFold analysis of other ubiquitin-specific proteases suggests that phosphorylation-regulated autoinhibition may be a feature of multiple USP enzymes. These findings shed light on the molecular mechanisms of H2AK119 deubiquitination and reveal a novel mode of phosphorylation-dependent DUB autoregulation.
abstract_zh: 单泛素化组蛋白H2A赖氨酸119（H2AK119ub）是与转录沉默和异染色质形成相关的标志性修饰。泛素特异性蛋白酶21（USP21）是靶向H2AK119ub的四种主要去泛素化酶（DUBs）之一，在多种细胞过程中发挥关键作用1–4。USP21特异性去泛素化H2AK119ub及其调控的分子机制尚不清楚。USP21包含一个C端USP催化结构域，其前有一个N端 intrinsically disordered region (IDR)。我们解析了USP21催化结构域与H2AK119ub核小体结合的冷冻电镜结构，揭示了一种与另外两种H2AK119特异性DUBs——Polycomb repressive complex 5和USP16 6——不同的识别模式。我们意外发现，USP21的N端 intrinsically disordered region (IDR) 抑制该酶的活性。利用AlphaFold-Multimer对USP21相互作用因子进行虚拟筛选，我们鉴定出能够磷酸化USP21 IDR并从而解除自抑制的激酶。使用AlphaFold3对USP21进行建模，提出了一个解释自抑制机制的结构模型。对其他泛素特异性蛋白酶的AlphaFold分析表明，磷酸化调控的自抑制可能是多种USP酶的共同特征。这些发现揭示了H2AK119去泛素化的分子机制，并展示了一种新型的磷酸化依赖性DUB自调控模式。
